title: USB charging points and phone tray
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on USB charging provision and the phone charging tray, but many fragments use the word "points" for unrelated subjects or lack enough context to assign clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the phone charging tray and describe the USB setup as useful for charging.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain about missing rear charging points for passengers and the lack of phone charging points in the back.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention USB-C charging points, charging-point shortages, boot tie-down points, ratings, or other brief references without enough context for reliable sentiment assignment.

limitations: This cluster mixes charging-related comments with unrelated uses of "points," such as ratings and boot anchor points.
